card.situation:
Midwest Janitorial MATOC — Army Corps of Engineers recruiting offices across IL, IN, KY, MI, and OH; ~7 FFP IDIQ awards, $20M shared ceiling, base + four option years.
Reached owner because NAICS 561720 is an exact match and Red Cedar is Total Small Business eligible, but the owner distance rule (rc-distance) flags all five states as out-of-range from Oklahoma City.
reasons_for: NAICS 561720 is an exact match for janitorial services and Red Cedar is fully eligible for the Total Small Business set-aside, clearing the threshold eligibility bar [profile: NAICS 561720 exact match; set_aside_note].

Relevant federal janitorial past performance (GSA federal building, VA outpatient clinic) and strong technical posture — CIMS-GB certification, green cleaning program, CMMS-based QC — would support a competitive proposal [profile: past performance, Oklahoma City Federal Building; outpatient clinic housekeeping].

The MATOC pool targets approximately seven awards, improving probability of selection and providing a long revenue runway (base + four option years, performance beginning 02 November 2026) ["Each IDIQ contract will include a one (1) year base and four (4) one (1) year option periods."].
reasons_against: All five places of performance (IL, IN, KY, MI, OH) are well over 200 miles from Oklahoma City, directly triggering the owner's standing no-bid distance rule [rc-distance].

Zero requirements rows survived validation — no line-by-line compliance assessment is possible, so technical risk and any mandatory qualifications remain entirely unknown [matrix_summary: 0 requirements checked (no matrix row survived validation)].

Red Cedar's workforce of 38 W-2 employees and past performance concentrated in Oklahoma have no footprint in the five-state Midwest region, creating serious staffing and mobilization risk for a $20M multi-state MATOC [profile: workforce 38 W-2 employees; gaps: no Midwest past performance].

drafts.capability_statement:
Red Cedar Facility Services — Capability Statement
Submitted in Response to: Midwest Janitorial MATOC (Notice ID: 4585b18bf9e745259b0be3e0289555c1)
Contracting Office: USACE Louisville District (W072 ENDIST LOUISVILLE)

Red Cedar Facility Services is a Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB) and Total Small Business fully eligible for this set-aside. Our NAICS code is 561720 (Janitorial Services) — an exact match for this requirement.

We deliver professional janitorial and custodial services to federal and state clients, including the GSA Oklahoma City Federal Building and a VA outpatient clinic. Our performance record demonstrates reliable service delivery in occupied, security-sensitive government facilities.

Our technical approach is built on three pillars:
• Quality Control: CMMS-based inspection and corrective-action tracking with documented close-out.
• Green Cleaning: An active green cleaning program aligned with federal sustainability objectives.
• Certification: CIMS-GB certification validates our systems-based approach to janitorial management.

Our 38 W-2 employees form a trained, vetted core workforce. We supplement with a qualified subcontractor and staffing network when task order scope requires additional coverage.

We are committed to responsive, compliant performance across all assigned locations and welcome the opportunity to discuss our qualifications further.

Point of Contact:
Red Cedar Facility Services

reader.scope_summary: The government is buying janitorial services for U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Military Recruiting Offices across Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Michigan, and Ohio. The contract vehicle is a Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC) pool of approximately seven firm-fixed-price IDIQ contracts, each with a one-year base period and four one-year option periods. The MATOC carries a total shared capacity of $20,000,000.00, with performance beginning 02 November 2026.
quotes: This Request for Proposal (RFP) is for Janitorial Services for the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers at various Military Recruiting Offices in the States of Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Michigan, and Ohio.

This solicitation is for the award of a Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC) pool consisting of approximately seven (7) firm-fixed-price Indefinite Quantity Indefinite Delivery (IDIQ) contracts.
Each IDIQ contract will include a one (1) year base and four (4) one (1) year option periods.
Task orders will typically be competed among the entire MATOC pool.
The MATOC will have a total (base year plus all option years) shared capacity of $20,000,000.00.
The period of performance will begin 02 November 2026.
